name: hq
description: One pane for every Claude Code session on your machine: what each is doing, which one needs you, and your PRs' checks. Press a session to jump to it.

colorBroken.title: Colour: broken
colorBroken.description: Failed checks, broken PRs, conflicts. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 1, the terminal's own palette slot.

colorWaiting.title: Colour: waiting
colorWaiting.description: A session or agent waiting on you, and the asks line. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 3, the terminal's own palette slot.

colorWorking.title: Colour: working
colorWorking.description: Running dots (and their dim pulse), checks in progress, busy sessions. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 4, the terminal's own palette slot.

colorDone.title: Colour: done
colorDone.description: Passed checks, merged PRs, finished agents, plan usage bars. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 2, the terminal's own palette slot.

colorAccent.title: Colour: accent
colorAccent.description: The focus bar and the cursor marker. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 6, the terminal's own palette slot.

colorDim.title: Colour: dim
colorDim.description: Borders and section dividers of cards with nothing broken or waiting. Accepts #rrggbb, ansi256(N) or a palette number N (0-255). Default 8, the terminal's own palette slot.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: Ask Haiku for each card's goal line and for short glosses of ticket and ADR ids. Off: no model calls; cards show the AI title or first prompt, ids bare. /hq summaries on|off overrides this on one machine.

wake.title: Wake on owned PRs
wake.description: Start a turn when a PR this session owns goes red, merges, conflicts or falls behind. Off: toasts only. /hq wake on|off overrides this on one machine.

notify.title: Notify
notify.description: A desktop notification when another session starts waiting on you. /hq notify on|off overrides this on one machine.

updateCheck.title: Check for updates
updateCheck.description: Once a day, fetch HQ's published plugin.json from GitHub and show a dim line in the pane header when a newer version is out. Off, or with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC set: no request.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the HQ pane by itself once per session. An unasked pane is drawn from 144 terminal columns (110 once you have opened it with /hq) and waits below that.
